verdict.rationale: WorkOS exposes a fully documented REST API accessible via official SDKs (e.g. @workos-inc/node), with llms.txt/docs.md machine-readable docs, and even ships a dedicated MCP server so AI agents can programmatically manage organizations, users, connections, etc. via the same API a human would use. CLI Auth (OAuth Device Flow) further supports non-interactive/agentic authentication.  missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/Swagger schema (probe found all candidate paths 404) and independent hands-on confirmation of API completeness beyond docs.
